title: Step 58-E auth session and security boundary
description: Implement only the backend-compatible storefront customer auth/session security boundary: server-only HttpOnly customer-session cookie forwarding and validated Set-Cookie relay, backend-authoritative session probe, protected-route state representation, sensitive response-header filtering and deterministic security verification. Do not implement login/account feature UI, client permission authority, admin auth, backend/OpenAPI/database mutations, Stage F or Step 59.

dependencies.name: Stage 58-D API client and server data foundation

acceptance_criteria.description: Customer session semantics are derived from the current backend/OpenAPI: HttpOnly customerSession cookie eqcofe_session or secure __Host-eqcofe_session, with backend session resolution remaining authoritative.

Browser code never reads or stores the session token; customer session forwarding is server-only and forwards only the allowed customer session cookie, never unrelated/admin cookies or invented Bearer authorization.

Backend Set-Cookie is filtered from generic API metadata and may be relayed only through a server-only validator enforcing customer cookie name, HttpOnly, Path=/, SameSite=Lax, host-only semantics and Secure for __Host-.
Backend-authoritative session probe represents authenticated, unauthenticated, expired, forbidden and recovery outcomes without parsing tokens or inventing customer permissions.

Deterministic runtime verification proves cookie isolation, 401 expiry, 403 forbidden, recovery, OTP Set-Cookie capture, logout clearing-cookie capture and security-attribute rejection while shell/API/repository verification remains green.

No login/account feature UI, admin auth frontend, client permission authority, refresh flow absent from contract, invented CSRF mechanism, backend/OpenAPI/database mutation, Stage F or Step59 implementation enters Stage E.
HIGH-risk canonical closure requires exact-artifact REVIEW, SECURITY, HUMAN and LOCK evidence plus verify/phase-a/merge-policy, protected merge and exact-SHA postmerge verification.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage E is HIGH risk. HUMAN evidence requires an explicit Project Owner decision on the exact artifact hash. Stage F and Step59 remain forbidden until protected transport and exact-SHA postmerge verification are green.
